featured_techniques.technique: Authentic leadership: blending personal identity with leadership style
Brand storytelling through personal memories (case example: Land's End)
Go beyond the ordinary to surprise customers
Removing corporate veneer to empower employees
Leadership authenticity as a driver of loyalty and growth
Earn customer trust by aligning personal decisions with business decisions
Encourage personality and creativity in place of formalism

summary: Jeanne Bliss argues that beloved, human-centered companies succeed by blending personal instincts with business decisions. She uses Land’s End’s Wisconsin-rooted, folksy branding as an example and urges leaders to draw on personal memories and flexibility to do what’s right for customers, rather than sticking to a corporate veneer. By empowering employees and encouraging personality and creativity, organizations can strengthen customer storytelling and loyalty, which in turn fuels growth.
title: Decide To Be Real: Authentic Leadership and Customer Loyalty (Decision 3)
topics: Blending personal instincts with business decisions
Flexibility and gut in decision making
